name: Builtin Cluster: Rolling Aggregates & Price Transforms
description: Tests: min, max, sum, var, linreg, linregslope, linregintercept, tsf, stderr, avgprice, medprice, typprice, wcprice. Rolling window aggregations and composite price calculations.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BUILTIN CLUSTER: Rolling Aggregates & Price Transforms
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
open_p = src.o
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c

# === ROLLING AGGREGATES ===
roll_min = min(period=20)(close)
roll_max = max(period=20)(close)
roll_sum = sum(period=20)(close)
roll_var = var(period=20)(close)

# === LINEAR REGRESSION FAMILY ===
lr = linreg(period=20)(close)
lr_slope = linregslope(period=20)(close)
lr_int = linregintercept(period=20)(close)
ts_forecast = tsf(period=20)(close)
std_err = stderr(close, 20)

# === PRICE TRANSFORMS (no period — computed from OHLC) ===
avg_p = avgprice()(open_p, high, low, close)
med_p = medprice()(high, low)
typ_p = typprice()(high, low, close)
wc_p = wcprice()(high, low, close)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Min/Max (20d)',
    category='Rolling',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Min(20)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Max(20)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, roll_min, roll_max))

xy_lines(
    title='Linear Regression (20d)',
    category='LinReg',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='LinReg', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TSF', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, lr, ts_forecast))

xy_lines(
    title='LinReg Slope & Std Error',
    category='LinReg',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Slope', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Std Error', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(lr_slope, std_err))

xy_lines(
    title='Price Composites: Avg, Med, Typ, WC',
    category='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='AvgPrice', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MedPrice', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TypPrice', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WCPrice', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(avg_p, med_p, typ_p, wc_p))
